description.short_caption: Skin lesion with erythema and central erosion after lateral pressure applied.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a localized skin lesion with surrounding erythema and a central erosion or ulceration. The lesion appears to be under examination, with gloved hands applying lateral pressure. The surrounding skin is mildly inflamed, and the lesion is well-demarcated. The gloves and sterile field suggest a clinical setting.

description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion with central pustule on the skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a localized erythematous lesion with a central pustule. The surrounding skin appears mildly inflamed, with a pink to red hue. The lesion is well-demarcated, and the pustule is small and white, suggesting a localized inflammatory or infectious process. The image is taken under natural lighting, and no additional diagnostic tools are visible.

This image shows a close-up view of the skin on the leg. There are two erythematous lesions, one larger and more prominent with central discoloration, and another smaller lesion nearby. The surrounding skin appears mildly inflamed but without significant swelling or drainage visible. The lesions suggest localized inflammation, possibly due to an infectious or inflammatory process.

description.detailed_description: The image shows a small, translucent larva placed on a blue background next to a pen for scale. The larva appears elongated with a tapering end and a visible breathing tube extending from its body. The pen provides a size reference, indicating the larva is small. The background and lighting emphasize the larva's structure.
